text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: Damping changes free-response shape while the initial displacement and velocity stay fixed

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned linear viscous damping and identical initial conditions for all curves. Underdamped motion uses ωd=ωn√(1−ζ²). Critical response is nonoscillatory;
the chosen overdamped response returns more slowly. Shapes depend on initial conditions, so absence of overshoot alone does not identify the damping regime
